features.title: Static cross-seat search MVP
features.behavior: A passenger can query the generated static timetable in Japanese, English, or Simplified Chinese and see conservative seat classifications and freshness.
out_of_scope: Browser-side calls to railway data sources

verification.expected: All Python and frontend checks pass, the site builds, and the preview serves its assets and three JSON files.

evidence.result: Passed: 9 Python tests, static-data validation, 18 frontend tests, production build, and preview checks for built assets plus all three JSON files.

features.notes: The UI discloses fixture mode and withholds a live timetable from the wrong Tokyo service date.

features.title: Server-side Yulog formation snapshot
features.behavior: Python can normalize Yulog's current-day diagram assignments into static latest.json without browser-side source requests.
out_of_scope: Reporting or POST requests to Yulog
Yulog as a station timetable source

verification.command: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' && python3 -m scripts.validation
verification.expected: Adapter tests pass and the checked-in generated JSON is valid.

evidence.result: Deployed latest.json identified Yulog with isMock=false.

features.notes: Repository Actions variable FORMATION_SOURCE is configured externally as yulog.

features.title: Permissioned real timetable
features.behavior: Passengers see reliable station-by-station train times instead of fixture services while formations continue to join by operating diagram.
in_scope: Operation-segment mapping including attach and detach cases
Removal of the fixture flag only after end-to-end verification
out_of_scope: HTML scraping in the user's browser

verification.expected: All checks pass against a non-fixture timetable and the search smoke journey returns verified services.

evidence.command: python3 -m scripts.update_data --source yulog --operation-revision 202603 && npm run verify
evidence.result: Passed: generated 433 JR Central services over 43 stations, mapped 409 services to published diagrams, split 10 attach/detach services, then passed 13 Python tests, validation, 19 frontend tests, build, and production smoke.

features.notes: Yulog mode refreshes the JR Central timetable and Yulog formations together; unmapped diagrams remain unknown.

features.title: Route-overlap-inclusive search
features.behavior: A passenger sees every upcoming same-direction train that operates over at least one segment of the selected corridor, classified as direct, first leg, or intermediate overlap without implying an unverified connection.
in_scope: Usable overlap display and connection-feasibility disclosure

verification.expected: Domain and UI tests cover all three route classes and one-station touches, then the production build and smoke checks pass.

evidence.result: Passed: 13 Python tests, static-data validation, 22 frontend tests covering all route classes, segment-only overlap, both directions, and departure-only ordering, then production build and smoke.

features.notes: Search remains globally sorted by the departure time at the start of each displayed usable segment.
